#!/bin/bash

# 编译并烧录 Vela AP 固件，然后打开串口终端

# 1. 进入项目目录

# 确认构建命令已经加载
type lunch >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "错误：lunch 命令未加载"
    exit 1
}

type m >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "错误：m 命令未加载"
    exit 1
}

# 3. 选择、清理并编译 AP 固件

m clean
m -j12

echo "========== 检查编译产物 =========="

AP_BIN="out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"

test -s "$AP_BIN" || {
    echo "错误：AP 固件缺失或为空：$AP_BIN"
    exit 1
}

ls -lh "$AP_BIN"

    "$AP_BIN" \
    --reboot

echo "========== 烧录完成，打开串口 =========="

# 6. 打开串口终端
exec sudo minicom -D /dev/ttyACM1 -b 921600

input.content:
#!/bin/bash
# cmd-runner attempt-006 flash launcher
# Flash O62 AP firmware vela_ap.bin (sha256 2735d20f...) via dldtool.
# Success = tool rc=0 AND PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED marker found.
set -u
ATTEMPT_DIR=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_cmd_runs/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ/common-ps3/attempt-006
SANDBOX=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_build_sandboxes/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ-attempt-005/mnt
ARTIFACT="$SANDBOX/out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"
LOG="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.log"
RESULT="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash-result.json"
RC_FILE="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.rc"

{
  echo "FLASH_STARTED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)"
  echo "FLASH_CWD=$SANDBOX"
  echo "FLASH_COMMAND=sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACM0 ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic --addr 0x2c1c0000 out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin --reboot"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ARTIFACT_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$ARTIFACT" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM0_SERIAL=$(udevadm info -q property -n /dev/ttyACM0 2>/dev/null | grep '^ID_SERIAL=' | cut -d= -f2-)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM0_FUSER=$(fuser /dev/ttyACM0 2>&1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM1_FUSER=$(fuser /dev/ttyACM1 2>&1)"
  echo "FLASH_TOOL_LAUNCHING=1"
} > "$LOG"

cd "$SANDBOX" || { echo "cd failed" >> "$LOG"; echo 2 > "$RC_FILE"; exit 2; }

# Run dldtool with a 960s (16min) hard timeout. dldtool self-exits on its own
# MAX-3-continuous-errors logic (~79 min worst case seen), but we cap at 16 min
# to match the previous 900s ceiling and avoid runaway waits.
timeout --signal=TERM 960 ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool \
    --pgm-rate 2000000 \
    /dev/ttyACM0 \
    ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
    --set-dual-chip 1 \
    --no-default-magic \
    --addr 0x2c1c0000 \
    out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin \
    --reboot >> "$LOG" 2>&1
TOOL_RC=$?
echo "FLASH_TOOL_RC=$TOOL_RC" >> "$LOG"

# Check for success marker (dldtool prints "PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED" on success)
if grep -q "PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED" "$LOG"; then
  SUCC=1
else
  SUCC=0
fi
echo "FLASH_SUCCESS_MARKER=$SUCC" >> "$LOG"
echo "FLASH_ENDED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)" >> "$LOG"

echo "$TOOL_RC" > "$RC_FILE"

# Write structured result
if [ "$TOOL_RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$SUCC" -eq 1 ]; then
  STATUS="PASS"
  DETAIL="tool rc=0 and PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED found"
else
  STATUS="FAIL"
  DETAIL="tool_rc=$TOOL_RC success_marker=$SUCC"
fi
cat > "$RESULT" <<EOF
{
  "started_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_STARTED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "ended_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_ENDED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "cwd": "$SANDBOX",
  "command": ["sudo","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool","--pgm-rate","2000000","/dev/ttyACM0","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin","--set-dual-chip","1","--no-default-magic","--addr","0x2c1c0000","out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin","--reboot"],
  "artifact": "$ARTIFACT",
  "artifact_sha256": "2735d20f219cd64861d1be6739a1595477e4599e488add978f3cf968f2b6fbcf",
  "tool_rc": $TOOL_RC,
  "success_marker_found": $([ $SUCC -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false),
  "status": "$STATUS",
  "detail": "$DETAIL"
}
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# attempt-006b flash launcher — allocates a pty for dldtool stdin via `script`
# so dldtool does not bail on "standard input is not a terminal device".
# Success = tool rc=0 AND PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED.
set -u
ATTEMPT_DIR=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_cmd_runs/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ/common-ps3/attempt-006b
SANDBOX=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_build_sandboxes/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ-attempt-005/mnt
ARTIFACT="$SANDBOX/out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"
LOG="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.log"
RC_FILE="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.rc"
RESULT="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash-result.json"

{
  echo "FLASH_STARTED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)"
  echo "FLASH_CWD=$SANDBOX"
  echo "FLASH_COMMAND=sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACM0 ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic --addr 0x2c1c0000 out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin --reboot"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ARTIFACT_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$ARTIFACT" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM0_SERIAL=$(udevadm info -q property -n /dev/ttyACM0 2>/dev/null | grep '^ID_SERIAL=' | cut -d= -f2-)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM0_FUSER=$(fuser /dev/ttyACM0 2>&1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ACM1_FUSER=$(fuser /dev/ttyACM1 2>&1)"
  echo "FLASH_TOOL_LAUNCHING=1"
} > "$LOG"

cd "$SANDBOX" || { echo "cd failed" >> "$LOG"; echo 2 > "$RC_FILE"; exit 2; }

# `script -qfc '<cmd>'` allocates a pty; dldtool sees a terminal on stdin.
# We wrap the dldtool invocation itself (sudo + dldtool) so sudo also has a tty.
timeout --signal=TERM 960 script -qfc "sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACM0 ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic --addr 0x2c1c0000 out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin --reboot" /dev/null >> "$LOG" 2>&1
TOOL_RC=$?
echo "FLASH_TOOL_RC=$TOOL_RC" >> "$LOG"

if grep -q "PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED" "$LOG"; then SUCC=1; else SUCC=0; fi
echo "FLASH_SUCCESS_MARKER=$SUCC" >> "$LOG"
echo "FLASH_ENDED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)" >> "$LOG"
echo "$TOOL_RC" > "$RC_FILE"

if [ "$TOOL_RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$SUCC" -eq 1 ]; then
  STATUS="PASS"; DETAIL="tool rc=0 and PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED found"
else
  STATUS="FAIL"; DETAIL="tool_rc=$TOOL_RC success_marker=$SUCC"
fi
cat > "$RESULT" <<EOF
{
  "started_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_STARTED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "ended_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_ENDED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "cwd": "$SANDBOX",
  "command": ["sudo","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool","--pgm-rate","2000000","/dev/ttyACM0","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin","--set-dual-chip","1","--no-default-magic","--addr","0x2c1c0000","out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin","--reboot"],
  "artifact": "$ARTIFACT",
  "artifact_sha256": "2735d20f219cd64861d1be6739a1595477e4599e488add978f3cf968f2b6fbcf",
  "tool_rc": $TOOL_RC,
  "success_marker_found": $([ $SUCC -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false),
  "status": "$STATUS",
  "detail": "$DETAIL"
}
EOF
echo "FLASH_STATUS=$STATUS" | tee -a "$LOG"
exit "$TOOL_RC"

## Symptom
- dldtool launched correctly this time (`isatty success!` — pty allocated via `script -qfc`, unlike attempt-006 which bailed on `standard input is not a terminal device`).
- Tool reached `main_loop/------ Wait for SYNC started ------` then produced **zero** further output for the full 960s until `timeout` sent TERM.

## Root cause (different from attempt-005)
- attempt-005: device responded to SYNC with malformed packets (`SYNC msg length error`, continuous errors) — handshake attempted but unstable.
- attempt-006b: device sent **nothing** on ACM0 — completely silent during the download window.

- ACM1 console (921600) IS ALIVE and running an interactive NSH shell. Prompt `ap>` observed.

The device is in **normal run mode** running an AP firmware that predates/omits the TFLM operator integration. dldtool requires the target to be in **download mode**; a normal-mode device does not answer the SYNC handshake on ACM0, so the flash cannot proceed.

- Build artifact `vela_ap.bin` (sha256 `2735d20f...`) verified intact in sandbox.

Place the O62 board into **download/programming mode** by whatever method is normal for this board (e.g. hold a specific key/button while resetting, or short the download strap, as per the board's BES programming procedure). The normal power-cycle/reset performed so far boots into normal run mode, not download mode.

#!/bin/bash
# attempt-007 flash launcher — second O62 unit, flash port /dev/ttyACM2
# Allocates a pty for dldtool stdin via `script -qfc`.
# Success = tool rc=0 AND PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED.
set -u
ATTEMPT_DIR=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_cmd_runs/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ/common-ps3/attempt-007
SANDBOX=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_build_sandboxes/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ-attempt-005/mnt
ARTIFACT="$SANDBOX/out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"
FLASH_PORT=/dev/ttyACM2
LOG="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.log"
RC_FILE="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash.rc"
RESULT="$ATTEMPT_DIR/flash-result.json"

{
  echo "FLASH_STARTED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)"
  echo "FLASH_CWD=$SANDBOX"
  echo "FLASH_PORT=$FLASH_PORT (serial baseline=578D028515)"
  echo "FLASH_COMMAND=sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 $FLASH_PORT ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic --addr 0x2c1c0000 out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin --reboot"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ARTIFACT_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$ARTIFACT" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_FLASH_PORT_SERIAL=$(udevadm info -q property -n $FLASH_PORT 2>/dev/null | grep '^ID_SERIAL=' | cut -d= -f2-)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_FLASH_PORT_FUSER=$(fuser $FLASH_PORT 2>&1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_CONSOLE_PORT_FUSER=$(fuser /dev/ttyACM3 2>&1)"
  echo "FLASH_TOOL_LAUNCHING=1"
} > "$LOG"

cd "$SANDBOX" || { echo "cd failed" >> "$LOG"; echo 2 > "$RC_FILE"; exit 2; }

timeout --signal=TERM 960 script -qfc "sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 $FLASH_PORT ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic --addr 0x2c1c0000 out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin --reboot" /dev/null >> "$LOG" 2>&1
TOOL_RC=$?
echo "FLASH_TOOL_RC=$TOOL_RC" >> "$LOG"

if grep -q "PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED" "$LOG"; then SUCC=1; else SUCC=0; fi
echo "FLASH_SUCCESS_MARKER=$SUCC" >> "$LOG"
echo "FLASH_ENDED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)" >> "$LOG"
echo "$TOOL_RC" > "$RC_FILE"

if [ "$TOOL_RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$SUCC" -eq 1 ]; then
  STATUS="PASS"; DETAIL="tool rc=0 and PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED found"
else
  STATUS="FAIL"; DETAIL="tool_rc=$TOOL_RC success_marker=$SUCC"
fi
cat > "$RESULT" <<EOF
{
  "started_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_STARTED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "ended_utc": "$(grep '^FLASH_ENDED_UTC' "$LOG" | cut -d= -f2-)",
  "cwd": "$SANDBOX",
  "flash_port": "$FLASH_PORT",
  "command": ["sudo","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool","--pgm-rate","2000000","$FLASH_PORT","./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin","--set-dual-chip","1","--no-default-magic","--addr","0x2c1c0000","out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin","--reboot"],
  "artifact": "$ARTIFACT",
  "artifact_sha256": "2735d20f219cd64861d1be6739a1595477e4599e488add978f3cf968f2b6fbcf",
  "tool_rc": $TOOL_RC,
  "success_marker_found": $([ $SUCC -eq 1 ] && echo true || echo false),
  "status": "$STATUS",
  "detail": "$DETAIL"
}
EOF
echo "FLASH_STATUS=$STATUS" | tee -a "$LOG"
exit "$TOOL_RC"

这强烈说明：**问题不在"哪台设备进没进下载模式"，而在 dldtool 的握手协议方式本身**。dldtool 是被动等设备先发 SYNC 包（`Wait for SYNC started`），但 BES 下载模式通常是**设备先主动发 SYNC 来宣告自己就绪**。如果设备的下载握手需要外部触发（比如复位时序），那 dldtool 启动后必须配合一个复位动作。

关键洞察：build_tflm.sh 和正常的 BES 烧录流程里，dldtool 启动后通常需要**对板子做一次复位**，设备才会在复位瞬间发 SYNC。也就是说 dldtool 的正确用法是：先启动 dldtool（它进入 Wait for SYNC），**然后立刻复位板子**，设备复位后会发 SYNC 包，dldtool 才能接上。

# dldtool Flash Commands Reference

Complete dldtool command reference for O62/O62LTE devices. All commands sourced from the official flashing guide.

> **Prerequisite**: All dldtool commands require a real TTY and must run inside a tmux session. Create one first: `tmux new-session -s flash-o62`

## Two Programmers

O62 uses two different programmer binaries depending on the target:

| Programmer | Target | Path |
|-----------|--------|------|
| NOR programmer | Flash 0/1 (bl, bl2, tee, ap, audio, cp) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin` |
| eMMC programmer | eMMC partitions (vendor, system, app, etc.) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin` |

## NOR Flash Address Map

### Flash 0

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| bootloader | 0x2c000000 - 0x2c040000 | 256KB |
| bootloader2 | 0x2c040000 - 0x2c0c0000 | 512KB |
| tee | 0x2c0c0000 - 0x2c1c0000 | 1MB |
| ap | 0x2c1c0000 - 0x2cc8E000 | 10MB + 824KB |
| audio | 0x2cc8E000 - 0x2cf8E000 | 3MB |
| sst | 0x2cf8E000 - 0x2CFFE000 | 448KB |
| reserve | 0x2cffe000 - 0x2d000000 | 8KB |

### Flash 1

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| cp | 0x34000000 - 0x343BF000 | 3836KB |
| misc | 0x343BF000 - 0x343FF000 | 256KB (littlefs, factory calibration) |
| factory | 0x343FF000 - 0x34400000 | 4KB (bes reserved) |

## eMMC Partition Address Map

| Partition | Start Block | Size | Content |
|-----------|------------|------|---------|
| vendor | 37 | 50MB | Dynamic loaded firmware (includes vela_sensor.bin) |
| system | 102437 | 150MB | System resources + OTA upgrade resources |
| app | 409637 | 300MB | Application resources |
| misc | 1024037 | 100MB | Audio resources, reserved for new app resources |
| i18n | 1228837 | 50MB | Translations |
| font | 1331237 | 50MB | Fonts |
| watchface | 1433637 | 200MB | Pre-installed watch faces |
| quickapp | 1843237 | 150MB | Pre-installed third-party apps |
| factory | 2150434 | 100MB | Factory resources + user version bin |
| store | 2355234 | 50MB | Store demo resources |
| nv | 2457634 | 10MB | Modem NV |
| data | 2478114 | 2232MB | User data (formatted on factory reset) |
| userlog | 7049250 | 100MB | Log storage |
| coredump | 7254050 | 100MB | Coredump storage (debug phase) |

## Single Core Flash Commands (NOR)

```bash
## AP
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x2c1c0000 <ap_dir>/vela_ap.bin \
  --reboot

## TEE
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x2c0c0000 <tee_dir>/vela_tee.bin \
  --reboot

## Audio
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  <audio_dir>/vela_audio.bin \
  --reboot

## CP
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 --no-default-magic \
  <cp_dir>/vela_cp.bin \
  --reboot

## Bootloader2 (no --no-default-magic!)
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 \
  --addr 0x2c040000 <bl2_dir>/vela_bl2.bin \
  --reboot
```

### Flash Sensor Only

Sensor is on the eMMC vendor partition, not NOR flash. It is packed into `vela_vendor.bin`.

**CI package**: `vela_vendor.bin` already includes sensor — flash it directly:

```bash
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin \
  --addr 37 emmc_images/vela_vendor.bin \
  --reboot
```

**Local build**: must repack sensor into vendor.bin first:

```bash
# 1. Copy sensor bin to vendor resource path
cp <sensor_dir>/vela_sensor.bin ./vendor/xiaomi/miwear/res/vendor/system

# 2. Generate vendor image (use -m o62 or -m lte for o62lte)
./vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/gen_emmc_img.sh -m o62

# 3. Flash vendor partition
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin \

#!/bin/bash

# 编译并烧录 Vela AP 固件，然后打开串口终端

# dldtool Flash Commands Reference

Complete dldtool command reference for O62/O62LTE devices. All commands sourced from the official flashing guide.

> **Prerequisite**: All dldtool commands require a real TTY and must run inside a tmux session. Create one first: `tmux new-session -s flash-o62`

## Two Programmers

O62 uses two different programmer binaries depending on the target:

| Programmer | Target | Path |
|-----------|--------|------|
| NOR programmer | Flash 0/1 (bl, bl2, tee, ap, audio, cp) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin` |
| eMMC programmer | eMMC partitions (vendor, system, app, etc.) | `./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin` |

## NOR Flash Address Map

### Flash 0

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| bootloader | 0x2c000000 - 0x2c040000 | 256KB |
| bootloader2 | 0x2c040000 - 0x2c0c0000 | 512KB |
| tee | 0x2c0c0000 - 0x2c1c0000 | 1MB |
| ap | 0x2c1c0000 - 0x2cc8E000 | 10MB + 824KB |
| audio | 0x2cc8E000 - 0x2cf8E000 | 3MB |
| sst | 0x2cf8E000 - 0x2CFFE000 | 448KB |
| reserve | 0x2cffe000 - 0x2d000000 | 8KB |

### Flash 1

| Partition | Address Range | Size |
|-----------|--------------|------|
| cp | 0x34000000 - 0x343BF000 | 3836KB |
| misc | 0x343BF000 - 0x343FF000 | 256KB (littlefs, factory calibration) |
| factory | 0x343FF000 - 0x34400000 | 4KB (bes reserved) |

## eMMC Partition Address Map

| Partition | Start Block | Size | Content |
|-----------|------------|------|---------|
| vendor | 37 | 50MB | Dynamic loaded firmware (includes vela_sensor.bin) |
| system | 102437 | 150MB | System resources + OTA upgrade resources |
| app | 409637 | 300MB | Application resources |
| misc | 1024037 | 100MB | Audio resources, reserved for new app resources |
| i18n | 1228837 | 50MB | Translations |
| font | 1331237 | 50MB | Fonts |
| watchface | 1433637 | 200MB | Pre-installed watch faces |
| quickapp | 1843237 | 150MB | Pre-installed third-party apps |
| factory | 2150434 | 100MB | Factory resources + user version bin |
| store | 2355234 | 50MB | Store demo resources |
| nv | 2457634 | 10MB | Modem NV |
| data | 2478114 | 2232MB | User data (formatted on factory reset) |
| userlog | 7049250 | 100MB | Log storage |
| coredump | 7254050 | 100MB | Coredump storage (debug phase) |

## Single Core Flash Commands (NOR)

```bash
## AP
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x2c1c0000 <ap_dir>/vela_ap.bin \
  --reboot

## TEE
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  --addr 0x2c0c0000 <tee_dir>/vela_tee.bin \
  --reboot

## Audio
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 --no-default-magic \
  <audio_dir>/vela_audio.bin \
  --reboot

## CP
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 0 --no-default-magic \
  <cp_dir>/vela_cp.bin \
  --reboot

## Bootloader2 (no --no-default-magic!)
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin \
  --set-dual-chip 1 \
  --addr 0x2c040000 <bl2_dir>/vela_bl2.bin \
  --reboot
```

### Flash Sensor Only

Sensor is on the eMMC vendor partition, not NOR flash. It is packed into `vela_vendor.bin`.

**CI package**: `vela_vendor.bin` already includes sensor — flash it directly:

```bash
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin \
  --addr 37 emmc_images/vela_vendor.bin \
  --reboot
```

**Local build**: must repack sensor into vendor.bin first:

```bash
# 1. Copy sensor bin to vendor resource path
cp <sensor_dir>/vela_sensor.bin ./vendor/xiaomi/miwear/res/vendor/system

# 2. Generate vendor image (use -m o62 or -m lte for o62lte)
./vendor/xiaomi/miwear/tools/gen_emmc_img.sh -m o62

# 3. Flash vendor partition
sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 /dev/ttyACMx \
  ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/emmc_programmer/emmc_programmer_o62_with_sign.bin \

#!/bin/bash
# attempt-009 四核串行烧录 — 第二台 O62 (/dev/ttyACM2 烧录口)
# 每核: tmux 内启动 dldtool 等 SYNC → 用户复位 → 烧录 → --reboot
# 用法: ./run-flash-core.sh <core_name>
#   core_name: bl2 | tee | ap | audio
set -u

CORE="${1:?usage: $0 <bl2|tee|ap|audio>}"
ATTEMPT_DIR=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_cmd_runs/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ/common-ps3/attempt-009/flash
WORKSPACE=/home/zhangyi101/project26/vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm
FLASH_PORT=/dev/ttyACM2
TMUX_SESSION="flash-o62-009-${CORE}"
LOG="$ATTEMPT_DIR/${CORE}.log"
RC_FILE="$ATTEMPT_DIR/${CORE}.rc"
RESULT="$ATTEMPT_DIR/${CORE}-result.json"

# 核 → 产物 + 地址 + magic 参数映射
case "$CORE" in
  bl2)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c040000"
    MAGIC=""                      # bl2 用默认 magic,不加 --no-default-magic
    ;;
  tee)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_tee/vela_tee.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c0c0000"
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  ap)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c1c0000"
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  audio)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_audio/vela_audio.bin"
    ADDR=""                       # audio 用默认地址 0x2cc8E000,不传 --addr
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unknown core: $CORE" >&2; exit 2;;
esac

# 组装 dldtool 命令
DLDCMD="sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool --pgm-rate 2000000 $FLASH_PORT ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1 $MAGIC"
if [ -n "$ADDR" ]; then
  DLDCMD="$DLDCMD --addr $ADDR $ARTIFACT --reboot"
else
  DLDCMD="$DLDCMD $ARTIFACT --reboot"
fi

{
  echo "FLASH_STARTED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)"
  echo "FLASH_CORE=$CORE"
  echo "FLASH_CWD=$WORKSPACE"
  echo "FLASH_PORT=$FLASH_PORT"
  echo "FLASH_COMMAND=$DLDCMD"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ARTIFACT_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$WORKSPACE/$ARTIFACT" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_FLASH_PORT_SERIAL=$(udevadm info -q property -n $FLASH_PORT 2>/dev/null | grep '^ID_SERIAL=' | cut -d= -f2-)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_FLASH_PORT_FUSER=$(fuser $FLASH_PORT 2>&1)"
  echo "TMUX_SESSION=$TMUX_SESSION"
  echo "FLASH_TOOL_LAUNCHING=1"
} > "$LOG"

cd "$WORKSPACE" || { echo "cd failed" >> "$LOG"; echo 2 > "$RC_FILE"; exit 2; }

# 确保端口权限
sudo chmod 666 "$FLASH_PORT" 2>/dev/null

# 杀掉可能残留的同名 tmux 会话
tmux kill-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null

# 在 tmux 里启动 dldtool (dldtool 需要 isatty stdin, tmux 提供 pty)
# 用 script -qfc 在 tmux 内再包一层 pty 确保 isatty
tmux new-session -d -s "$TMUX_SESSION" \
  "timeout --signal=TERM 960 bash -c 'script -qfc \"$DLDCMD\" /dev/null >> $LOG 2>&1; echo TMUX_DLD_RC=\$? >> $LOG; echo TMUX_DLD_DONE=1 >> $LOG'"

echo "tmux session '$TMUX_SESSION' started, dldtool waiting for SYNC on $FLASH_PORT"
echo ">>> 请复位第二台 O62 设备触发 SYNC (dldtool 已在等) <<<"
echo ">>> 监控: tail -f $LOG <<<"

#!/bin/bash
# attempt-009 四核串行烧录 — 第二台 O62 (/dev/ttyACM2 烧录口)
# 方案: tmux + script -qfc 包裹 dldtool, 确保 stdin/stdout 都是 pty (isatty 通过 + 行缓冲)
#        tmux pipe-pane 同步输出到 log 文件
# 用法: ./run-flash-core.sh <core_name>
#   core_name: bl2 | tee | ap | audio
set -u

CORE="${1:?usage: $0 <bl2|tee|ap|audio>}"
ATTEMPT_DIR=/home/zhangyi101/project26/tflm_cmd_runs/run-20260826T015831Z-Htc5NQ/common-ps3/attempt-009/flash
WORKSPACE=/home/zhangyi101/project26/vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm
FLASH_PORT=/dev/ttyACM2
TMUX_SESSION="flash009-${CORE}"
LOG="$ATTEMPT_DIR/${CORE}.log"

# 核 → 产物 + 地址 + magic 参数映射
case "$CORE" in
  bl2)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_bootloader2/vela_bl2.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c040000"
    MAGIC=""                      # bl2 用默认 magic
    ;;
  tee)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_tee/vela_tee.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c0c0000"
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  ap)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_ap/vela_ap.bin"
    ADDR="0x2c1c0000"
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  audio)
    ARTIFACT="out/bes_o62_audio/vela_audio.bin"
    ADDR=""                       # audio 默认地址 0x2cc8E000
    MAGIC="--no-default-magic"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unknown core: $CORE" >&2; exit 2;;
esac

# dldtool 参数
ARGS="--pgm-rate 2000000 $FLASH_PORT ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/programmer_dual_chip_with_sign.bin --set-dual-chip 1"
[ -n "$MAGIC" ] && ARGS="$ARGS $MAGIC"
[ -n "$ADDR" ] && ARGS="$ARGS --addr $ADDR"
ARGS="$ARGS $ARTIFACT --reboot"

# 元数据
{
  echo "FLASH_STARTED_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6N+00:00)"
  echo "FLASH_CORE=$CORE"
  echo "FLASH_CWD=$WORKSPACE"
  echo "FLASH_PORT=$FLASH_PORT"
  echo "FLASH_ARGS=$ARGS"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_ARTIFACT_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$WORKSPACE/$ARTIFACT" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  echo "IMMEDIATE_FLASH_PORT_SERIAL=$(udevadm info -q property -n "$FLASH_PORT" 2>/dev/null | grep '^ID_SERIAL=' | cut -d= -f2-)"
  echo "TMUX_SESSION=$TMUX_SESSION"
} > "$LOG"

cd "$WORKSPACE" || { echo "cd failed" >> "$LOG"; exit 2; }

sudo chmod 666 "$FLASH_PORT" 2>/dev/null
tmux kill-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null

# tmux new-session, pipe-pane 写 log, pane 内跑 script -qfc 包裹的 dldtool
# script -qfc: 分配 pty, dldtool stdin/stdout 均为 tty, isatty 通过 + 行缓冲
tmux new-session -d -s "$TMUX_SESSION" "cd '$WORKSPACE' && script -qfc 'sudo ./vendor/bes/prebuild/m1/dldtool $ARGS' /dev/null"
# pipe-pane 把 pane 输出同步到 log (追加)
tmux pipe-pane -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -o "cat >> '$LOG'"

echo "tmux session '$TMUX_SESSION' started"
echo "dldtool waiting for SYNC on $FLASH_PORT (core=$CORE)"
echo ">>> 请复位第二台 O62 设备触发 SYNC <<<"
echo "监控: tail -f $LOG"

text:
根因清楚了。ap 烧录**不是 SYNC 问题**,而是**烧到 sec_seq=103 时通信中断**(programmer 端掉线)。分析:

- SYNC 握手成功(line 25-30),erase 正常开始
- 烧到 sec_seq=103(len=32768)后,programmer 不再回复
- dldtool 尝试重连(programmer_sync),4 次连续 timeout,退出
- 共烧了 104 个扇区 = 104 × 32768 = 3,407,872 字节,而 AP 是 11,097,884 字节——只烧了 30%,通信就断了

这是**通信中断**(programmer 端掉线),不是握手问题。可能原因:
1. USB 连接不稳定(线/接触/供电)
2. 高速烧录(--pgm-rate 2000000)大文件时 USB 压力大导致掉线
3. 设备在烧录中异常 reset

前两核(bl2 403KB、tee 1MB)都成功了,只有 ap(11MB)失败——说明大文件长时间传输暴露了通信稳定性问题。

先确认设备当前状态(是否还在 download mode 还是已 reboot),然后重试。可能需要降速或检查 USB。

这是异常状态。分析所有可能性:

1. **复位没生效**:用户按了 reset 但设备没真正重启(或 reset 键无效)
2. **设备死机**:MCU 卡在某个状态,既不 boot 也不进 download mode
3. **secure boot 失败死循环**:bl2/tee/ap 版本链断了,boot 在 bl2 阶段就失败,但 bl2 的错误日志可能输出到不同通道

关键问题:之前 bl2/tee/ap **烧录都成功了**(PROGRAMMING SUCCEEDED),secure boot version 都是 4。按理版本应该匹配。但 audio 还是**旧固件**——audio 旧固件和新的 bl2/tee/ap 之间,如果 audio 参与了 boot 校验链(audio 核在 AP 启动后才由 AP 唤醒),audio 不匹配可能导致 AP 启动后 hang,但不应该让 MCU 完全无输出。

另一个可能:**第一台设备的 dldtool**(PID 1555197 那个 lc3-perf-results 的)还在 ACM0 跑,占着 USB HUB 带宽,导致第二台设备通信异常。先确认那个是否还在,以及是否干扰。

import os, time, termios, select, sys

def probe(port, baud=921600, label=""):
    try:
        fd = os.open(port, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOCTTY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        # 设置波特率
        attrs = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
        speed = {9600:termios.B9600, 115200:termios.B115200, 921600:termios.B921600}[baud]
        attrs[0] = []  # iflag
        attrs[1] = []  # oflag
        attrs[2] = termios.CS8 | termios.CREAD | termios.CLOCAL
        attrs[2] = termios.cflag_to_speed(baud) if hasattr(termios,'cflag_to_speed') else (termios.B921600 if baud==921600 else termios.B115200)
        # 用 cfsetispeed/ospeed
        try:
            import termios as t
            attrs = list(attrs)
        except: pass
        termios.cfsetispeed(attrs, speed)
        termios.cfsetospeed(attrs, speed)
        attrs[2] = attrs[2] & ~termios.CSIZE
        attrs[2] = attrs[2] | termios.CS8
        attrs[2] = attrs[2] & ~termios.PARENB
        attrs[2] = attrs[2] & ~termios.CSTOPB
        attrs[2] = attrs[2] | termios.CREAD | termios.CLOCAL
        attrs[3] = 0  # lflag: raw
        attrs[4] = speed  # ispeed
        attrs[5] = speed  # ospeed
        termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSANOW, attrs)
        termios.tcflush(fd, termios.TCIOFLUSH)
        # 设回阻塞
        fl = os.fcntl(fd, os.F_GETFL)
        os.fcntl(fd, os.F_SETFL, fl & ~os.O_NONBLOCK)
        # 发命令
        os.write(fd, b"\r\nhelp\r\n")
        # 读 5 秒
        buf = b""
        t0 = time.time()
        while time.time() - t0 < 5:
            r,_,_ = select.select([fd],[],[],0.5)
            if r:
                try:
                    d = os.read(fd, 4096)
                    if d:
                        buf += d
                except OSError:
                    break
        os.close(fd)
        print(f"[{label}] {port}@{baud}: got {len(buf)} bytes")
        if buf:
            try:
                print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace')[:500])
            except:
                print(repr(buf[:200]))
        return len(buf)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{label}] {port}@{baud}: ERROR {e}")
        return 0

- **ACM3(第二台控制台):0 字节,完全静默**

- 第二台设备 USB 串口芯片在线(供电 OK),但 MCU 端无任何输出
- 第一台正常,排除 USB HUB/环境问题
- 第二台是**我烧录后导致的** — bl2/tee/ap 烧录后设备无法启动

但 `dldtool` 探测第二台无 SYNC — 设备也没进 download mode。结合"断电重启也静默":设备 MCU 烧录后无法启动,既不 boot 也不进 download mode 的握手。这是**半砖状态**。

但等等——第一台有输出说明我的探测方法是对的(ACM1 有 655 字节)。第二台 ACM3 确实死。

关键:第一台的 `ap>` prompt 现在能否用?第一台有 sensor log flooding(和 attempt-006b 记录一致)。第一台如果也有 `tflm_benchmark`... 不,第一台是旧固件没有 tflm。

但第一台至少证明:**如果第二台启动正常,ACM3 会有输出**。第二台死了。

现在需要救砖。第二台 MCU 不启动——最可能是 bl2(第一级 bootloader)有问题。但 bl2 烧录报成功了。

不过,有个更可能的原因:**secure boot 校验失败**。如果 ap 镜像的签名和 tee/bl2 的 secure boot key 不匹配,bl2 启动校验 ap 时会失败,设备可能停在 bl2 阶段甚至不输出(bl2 校验失败前不打印)。

但 bl2/tee/ap 都是同一天从同一个工作区编的,签名 key 应该一致... 除非**原工作区的签名 key 和设备硬件的 secure boot fuse 不匹配**。

最稳妥的救砖:**重新烧 bl2**,用断电重启后的干净时序确保进 download mode。但刚才探测显示第二台断电后没进 download mode(无 SYNC)。BES 设备通常上电后如果检测到 USB 连接且特定条件会进 download mode——也许需要特定的上电时序(按住某个键 + 上电)。

先让我确认:第二台 MCU 是否真的"死"还是在某种待机。用 dldtool 用更长的等待探测一次(也许设备上电后要等几秒才进 download mode)。

import serial, time, re
s = serial.Serial("/dev/ttyACM1", 921600, timeout=0.1)

def clean_cmd(c, wait=4.0):
    # 发命令前清空缓冲
    s.reset_input_buffer()
    # 持续读 0.3 秒清旧 sensor
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 0.3:
        s.read(16384)
    s.write((c+"\r\n").encode())
    out = b""
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < wait:
        d = s.read(8192)
        if d: out += d
    txt = out.decode('utf-8','replace')
    # 提取非 sensor 行,保留顺序
    lines = txt.split('\n')
    clean = [l for l in lines if 'get_cur_batty' not in l and 'temperature protect' not in l]
    # 合并连续空行
    result = []
    prev_empty = False
    for l in clean:
        if not l.strip():
            if not prev_empty:
                result.append(l)
            prev_empty = True
        else:
            result.append(l)
            prev_empty = False
    return '\n'.join(result)

NSH 的 `echo` 对复杂引号处理不可靠。换更稳的方式:**直接逐字符写文件**太慢。

更好思路:**绕过 flood 污染——关闭 sensor flood 源**。flood 来自 sensor 核经 syslog。NuttX `setlogmask` 可过滤 priority。之前试 `setlogmask 8` 没用(因为来自 rpmsg)。

换思路:**flood 字节是 syslog 经 console 输出**。如果 console syslog 能关掉... NuttX 有 `syslog` 配置。运行时:`syslog` 命令?或 `dmesg -n`(设日志级别)。

但其实最简单可靠的:**用 `mw`(memory write)或 `rb`/`wb` 二进制写文件**——不,太复杂。

<grid cols="2">
  <column width="50">

- **RAM（激活峰值）**：推理时所有非输入、非输出、非常量的中间激活张量字节数之和，为上界估计（各模型独立推理，不含算子重用优化）。
- **Hybrid 量化**：部分算子层保留 float32 权重、部分层做 int8 量化。`hybrid`（全量）= 多数层 int8；`hybrid_gru_only` = 仅 GRU 层保留 float32 其余 int8。
- **部署提示**：TFLM 实际 Flash 占用 ≈ 权重 ROM + schema/算子代码 + 对齐填充；实际 arena RAM 通常小于激活总和（取决于算子重用规划）。
- **数据来源**：onnx（initializer + value_info）、tflite（flatbuffers schema 直读 Buffer/Tensor，绕过 custom op 加载）。attengru/sleep 含 LAYER_NORM custom op，故 tflite 经 schema 直读而非 interpreter。

拿到设备 `free` 输出。但这是 **AP 核空闲态**的 heap——任务要求"运行时统计",应该反映 **TFLM 推理时的内存占用**(推理过程中 arena/heap 的实际使用)。需要在跑 benchmark 的同时/之后抓 free,或者对比推理前后的 maxused。

更准确的做法:
1. 先抓空闲态 free(已有)
2. 跑一次 benchmark(TFLM 推理),推理结束后再抓 free —— `maxused` 会反映推理峰值
3. 对比两次,得出 TFLM 推理带来的 ROM 权重占用 + RAM arena 占用

先跑 benchmark 后再抓 free:

推理后 free 和空闲态**完全相同**——`Umem` maxused 都是 14114496,说明 TFLM 推理的 arena 走的是**独立分配**(不在 Umem heap 里),或者 benchmark 进程退出后 arena 已释放,maxused 不保留。

这其实符合 TFLM 设计:arena 是 benchmark 进程内 mmap/malloc 的一大块,进程退出即释放。`free` 看的是**当前存活 heap**,看不到已退出的 benchmark 的峰值。

所以 `free` 指令反映的是**设备常驻运行时的 heap 占用**,不包含 TFLM 推理的瞬时 arena。要拿 TFLM 的 arena/ROM,应该从 **benchmark 自身输出**里读——之前 A/B 结果里就有:
- `Arena Total 97088 Bytes`、`NonPersistent 66560`、`Persistent 30528`
- `AllocateTensors 31372 ticks`
- 模型文件大小 339120 B(部署到 /data)

## 完成总结

已按你要求完成实机运行时 ROM/RAM 统计并更新到飞书文档:

### 做了什么
1. 在 O62 实机(AP 核)跑 `free` 指令,拿到 6 个 heap 的运行时占用数据
2. 对比推理前后 `free`,确认 TFLM arena 不计入常驻 heap 峰值
3. 结合 benchmark arena 报告,补全 TFLM 推理时的 ROM/RAM 占用
4. 把结果写入 [飞书文档](https://mi.feishu.cn/docx/ZXbtdI2AjoGIP9xVzTAc7uFwn6b) 的"# 实机上:"段落

### 关键数据

**设备常驻 RAM(heap,`free` 指令)**:
- Umem:23.85 MB 总 / 13.07 MB 已用 / 10.78 MB 空闲
- GImageCache:10 MB 总 / 9.77 MB 已用(几乎占满)
- AP 核常驻合计 ≈ 22.84 MB,可用空闲 ≈ 11.01 MB

**TFLM 推理时占用**(模型 + arena):
- 模型权重 ROM:339,120 B ≈ **331.2 KB**(pnet_v3_conv1 浮点模型)
- Arena RAM:97,088 B ≈ **94.8 KB**(NonPersistent 65 KB + Persistent 30 KB)

### 工程发现
- **`free` 看不到 TFLM arena 峰值** — TFLM arena 是 benchmark 进程内独立分配,进程退出即释放,`maxused` 不保留。所以文档里明确区分了"常驻 heap"(`free`)和"推理 arena"(benchmark 报告)两个口径。
- 实机结论:pnet_v3 浮点模型部署占用 ROM ≈ 331 KB + arena ≈ 95 KB,在 AP 核剩余 10.78 MB 空闲中占比 < 1%,内存充裕。

## 测试目的

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate TFLM test data + model headers for hr_pnet_test embedding.

Produces 4 .h files in the layout expected by accnet_hybrid_test-style tests:
  <name>_model_data.h        : alignas(16) const uint8_t g_<name>_model[N]
                               + const int g_<name>_model_len
  <name>_test_data.h         : const uint8_t g_<name>_input[bytes]
                               + const int g_<name>_input_size
                               + const uint8_t g_<name>_ref_output_bytes[bytes]
                               + const int g_<name>_ref_output_size

Reference path is XNNPACK delegate (tf.lite.Interpreter default), matching the
embedded TFLM Cortex-M55 fma chain per references/reference-and-tolerance.md.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys
import types

fake = types.ModuleType("tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper")
fake.MetricsWrapper = type("MetricsWrapper", (), {})
sys.modules["tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"] = fake

import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf


def emit_uint8_array(name, data: bytes, alignas16=False, header_comment=""):
    lines = []
    if header_comment:
        lines.append(header_comment)
    align = "alignas(16) " if alignas16 else ""
    lines.append(f"{align}const uint8_t {name}[{len(data)}] = {{")
    for i in range(0, len(data), 16):
        chunk = data[i : i + 16]
        hexes = ", ".join(f"0x{b:02x}" for b in chunk)
        sep = "," if i + 16 < len(data) else ""
        lines.append(f"  {hexes}{sep}")
    lines.append("};")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def emit_model_header(out_path, name_id, model_path):
    with open(model_path, "rb") as f:
        model_bytes = f.read()
    guard = f"{name_id.upper()}_MODEL_DATA_H_"
    body = []
    body.append(f"// Auto-generated model data for {name_id}")
    body.append(f"// Source: {os.path.basename(model_path)} ({len(model_bytes)} bytes)")
    body.append(f"#ifndef {guard}")

## 仓库里生成 .bin 输入/验证数据的脚本

有 **2 个脚本**直接 `.tofile()` 生成 .bin,另 1 个读取 .bin:

| 脚本 | 生成什么 | 数据来源 | 输出位置 |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| **`PTQ_hr_pnet/scripts/generate_tflm_test_data.py`** | `<name>_model_data.h`(模型C数组)+ `<name>_test_data.h`(input/ref C数组) | seed=42 随机输入 + XNNPACK 参考输出 | .h 头文件(**不直接产 .bin**,产 C 数组;但内容等价于 v2 的 input/ref) |
| **`PTQ_hr_pnet/scripts/export_v3_wrapper_fixture.py`** | `pnet_v3_input.bin`(8MB)+ `pnet_v3_ref.bin`(500KB)+ `pnet_v3_conv1_input.bin`(34KB)+ `pnet_v3_conv1_filter.bin`+ `pnet_v3_conv1_bias.bin` | 从 `ppg_test_input_v3.npy` / `ppg_test_output_v3.npy` + 模型权重 | `PTQ_hr_pnet/models_v3/wrapper_fixture/` |
| **`PTQ_hr_attengru/scripts/generate_headers.py`** | `hr_test_ref.bin`(**读取**而非生成:若该 .bin 存在则读入,否则用 XNNPACK 现算) | XNNPACK 参考输出 | `tflm_out/.../hr_test/` |

### 关键发现

1. **只有 pnet 系列有生成 .bin 的脚本**,而且分两套:
   - **v2**: `generate_tflm_test_data.py` — 产 .h 头文件(g_hr_input/g_hr_ref),seed=42 随机输入,**不产独立 .bin 文件**。但 `PTQ_hr_pnet/models/` 里的 `hr_pnet_v2_input.bin`(1KB)/`hr_pnet_v2_ref.bin`(256B)就是它附带生成的。
   - **v3**: `export_v3_wrapper_fixture.py` — 用**真实测试数据**(2000 样本 npy)+ 模型权重导出 .bin,这是本次 F32 wrapper 验证用的 fixture。

2. **accnet / attengru v2-v3 / sleeping 没有生成 .bin 的脚本**:
   - accnet:无 TFLM fixture,只走 PC 端 .npy 验证
   - attengru:用 .h 头文件格式(g_hr_input/g_hr_ref 字节数组),不是独立 .bin

input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Export .bin input/reference fixtures for accnet, attengru, sleeping models.

Mirrors PTQ_hr_pnet/scripts/export_v3_wrapper_fixture.py: dumps raw float32
(or int8 where the model is quantized) byte streams to .bin files so TFLM on
the device can load them with a plain fread, plus a manifest.json describing
shapes/sample counts.

Data sources (all float32 unless noted):
  accnet_v3   : PTQ_accnet/source/acc_test_input_v3.npy  (2000, 3, 256)
                PTQ_accnet/source/acc_test_output_v3.npy (2000, 1, 64)
                Model is int8 quantized; we export the float32 source data
                AND the int8-quantized single-sample input so TFLM can feed
                the int8 model directly. Reference output = float32 GT from
                npy (model-independent ground truth).
  attengru_v3  : PTQ_hr_attengru/source/test_data_v3.npz (2000 samples)
                Model has custom op (LAYER_NORM), PC cannot run it; npz carries
                input+output GT. Export each tensor as its own .bin, named by
                the tensor key (input_N_<name>.bin / output_N_<name>.bin).
  sleeping1    : PTQ_sleeping/source/data/sleepdata0.csv (1203 rows, 49 features)
                Model input [1,1800,49], output [1,1800,4]. CSV rows < 1800 so
                zero-pad to 1800. Run the float32 model on device host to get
                ref, OR if a ref is unavailable, export input only and let the
                device tflm_benchmark compute ref at runtime.

Usage:
  python export_bin_fixtures.py accnet_v3 --dest PTQ_accnet/fixtures
  python export_bin_fixtures.py attengru_v3 --dest PTQ_hr_attengru/fixtures
  python export_bin_fixtures.py sleeping1 --dest PTQ_sleeping/fixtures
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import shutil
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

# ai_edge_litert pulls a broken metrics wrapper on import; stub it.
fake_mod = types.ModuleType(
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
)
fake_mod.MetricsWrapper = type("MetricsWrapper", (), {})
sys.modules[
    "tensorflow.lite.python.metrics._pywrap_tensorflow_lite_metrics_wrapper"
] = fake_mod

import numpy as np

LE_FLOAT32 = np.dtype("<f4")
LE_INT8 = np.dtype("|i1")

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _to_bin(arr: np.ndarray, path: Path) -> None:
    """Write a contiguous little-endian array to a .bin file."""
    arr = np.ascontiguousarray(arr)
    if arr.dtype.byteorder == ">":
        arr = arr.astype(arr.dtype.newbyteorder("<"))
    arr.tofile(str(path))
    print(f"  wrote {path.name}: shape={list(arr.shape)} dtype={arr.dtype} "
          f"bytes={arr.nbytes}")


def _write_manifest(dest: Path, manifest: dict) -> None:
    with (dest / "manifest.json").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")
    print(f"  wrote manifest.json")


def _try_make_interpreter(model_path: Path):
    """Best-effort Interpreter; returns None if custom op blocks allocation."""
    try:
        from ai_edge_litert.interpreter import Interpreter
        interp = Interpreter(model_path=str(model_path))
        interp.allocate_tensors()
        return interp
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        if "unresolved custom op" in str(exc) or "failed to prepare" in str(exc):
            print(f"  [skip interpreter] {exc}".splitlines()[0])
            return None
        raise


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# accnet v3
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def export_accnet_v3(dest: Path) -> None:
    model = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_accnet/models_v3/MiHr_accnet_v3_int8.tflite"
    in_npy = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_accnet/source/acc_test_input_v3.npy"
    out_npy = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_accnet/source/acc_test_output_v3.npy"

    full_in = np.ascontiguousarray(np.load(in_npy), dtype=LE_FLOAT32)   # (2000,3,256)
    full_out = np.ascontiguousarray(np.load(out_npy), dtype=LE_FLOAT32)  # (2000,1,64)
    assert full_in.shape == (2000, 3, 256), full_in.shape
    assert full_out.shape == (2000, 1, 64), full_out.shape

    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(model, dest / "accnet_v3_model.tflite")

    # float32 single-sample input + GT reference (model-independent ground truth)
    sample_in = full_in[0:1]    # (1,3,256)
    sample_ref = full_out[0:1]  # (1,1,64)
    _to_bin(sample_in, dest / "accnet_v3_input_f32.bin")
    _to_bin(sample_ref, dest / "accnet_v3_ref_f32.bin")

    # int8-quantized single-sample input (so TFLM can feed the int8 model directly)
    interp = _try_make_interpreter(model)
    if interp is not None:
        in_det = interp.get_input_details()[0]
        out_det = interp.get_output_details()[0]
        qp_in = in_det["quantization"]   # (scale, zero_point) or ()
        qp_out = out_det["quantization"]
        if qp_in and qp_in[0] and qp_in[1] is not None:
            scale, zp = qp_in[0], qp_in[1]
            int8_in = np.round(sample_in / scale + zp).astype(LE_INT8)
            _to_bin(int8_in, dest / "accnet_v3_input_int8.bin")
        if qp_out and qp_out[0] and qp_out[1] is not None:
            scale, zp = qp_out[0], qp_out[1]
            int8_ref = np.round(sample_ref / scale + zp).astype(LE_INT8)
            _to_bin(int8_ref, dest / "accnet_v3_ref_int8.bin")

    manifest = {
        "model": "MiHr_accnet_v3_int8.tflite",
        "input_shape": list(sample_in.shape),
        "output_shape": list(sample_ref.shape),
        "input_dtype": "int8 (model), float32 source in *_f32.bin",
        "output_dtype": "int8 (model), float32 GT in *_f32.bin",
        "full_samples": 2000,
        "files": {
            "accnet_v3_input_f32.bin": "float32 single-sample input",
            "accnet_v3_ref_f32.bin": "float32 single-sample GT output",
            "accnet_v3_input_int8.bin": "int8-quantized input (if model is int8)",

        },
    }
    _write_manifest(dest, manifest)
    print(f"Exported accnet_v3 fixture to {dest}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# attengru v3
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def export_attengru_v3(dest: Path) -> None:
    model = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_hr_attengru/models_v3/attengru_v3_fused.tflite"
    npz_path = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_hr_attengru/source/test_data_v3.npz"
    data = np.load(npz_path)

    # sample count = max N in input_N_*
    import re
    sample_ids = set()
    input_keys = []
    output_keys = []
    for k in data.files:
        m = re.match(r"(input|output)_(\d+)_(.+)", k)
        if not m:
            continue
        kind, idx, name = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)
        sample_ids.add(idx)
        if kind == "input":
            input_keys.append((idx, name, k))
        else:
            output_keys.append((idx, name, k))
    n_samples = max(sample_ids) + 1
    input_names = sorted({name for _, name, _ in input_keys})
    output_names = sorted({name for _, name, _ in output_keys})

    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(model, dest / "attengru_v3_model.tflite")

    # export sample 0 (each tensor its own .bin) + a concatenated all-sample bin
    for idx, name, key in sorted(input_keys)[:len(input_names)]:
        arr = np.ascontiguousarray(data[key], dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
        _to_bin(arr, dest / f"attengru_v3_input_{name}.bin")
    for idx, name, key in sorted(output_keys)[:len(output_names)]:
        arr = np.ascontiguousarray(data[key], dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
        _to_bin(arr, dest / f"attengru_v3_output_{name}.bin")

    # also dump all samples concatenated for batch validation
    for name in input_names:
        key0 = f"input_0_{name}"
        # collect all samples (assumes uniform shape)
        arrs = [np.ascontiguousarray(data[f"input_{i}_{name}"], dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
                for i in range(n_samples)]
        all_arr = np.stack(arrs, axis=0)
        _to_bin(all_arr, dest / f"attengru_v3_input_{name}_all.bin")
    for name in output_names:
        arrs = [np.ascontiguousarray(data[f"output_{i}_{name}"], dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
                for i in range(n_samples)]
        all_arr = np.stack(arrs, axis=0)
        _to_bin(all_arr, dest / f"attengru_v3_output_{name}_all.bin")

    manifest = {
        "model": "attengru_v3_fused.tflite",
        "note": "model has custom op (LAYER_NORM), PC cannot run; "
                "input/output GT come from test_data_v3.npz",
        "n_samples": n_samples,
        "input_tensors": input_names,
        "output_tensors": output_names,
        "single_sample_files": [f"attengru_v3_input_{n}.bin" for n in input_names]
                               + [f"attengru_v3_output_{n}.bin" for n in output_names],
        "all_sample_files": [f"attengru_v3_input_{n}_all.bin" for n in input_names]
                            + [f"attengru_v3_output_{n}_all.bin" for n in output_names],
    }
    _write_manifest(dest, manifest)
    print(f"Exported attengru_v3 fixture to {dest}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sleeping1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def export_sleeping1(dest: Path) -> None:
    model = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_sleeping/source/funt_apple_2026-01-01-12-37-22.tflite"
    csv_path = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_sleeping/source/data/sleepdata0.csv"

    # read CSV: first 49 columns are features; pad/truncate to 1800 rows
    rows = []
    with open(csv_path, newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        for row in reader:
            feats = [float(x) for x in row[:49]]
            rows.append(feats)
    n_rows = len(rows)
    feat_len = 49
    win = 1800
    arr = np.zeros((1, win, feat_len), dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
    use_rows = min(n_rows, win)
    arr[0, :use_rows, :] = np.asarray(rows[:use_rows], dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
    print(f"  CSV: {n_rows} rows, {feat_len} features; "
          f"{'padded' if n_rows < win else 'truncated'} to {win}")

    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(model, dest / "sleeping1_model.tflite")
    _to_bin(arr, dest / "sleeping1_input.bin")

    # compute reference output via interpreter (float32 model, no custom op)
    interp = _try_make_interpreter(model)
    if interp is not None:
        in_det = interp.get_input_details()[0]
        assert list(in_det["shape"]) == [1, win, feat_len], \
            f"model input shape {in_det['shape']} != expected [1,{win},{feat_len}]"
        interp.set_tensor(in_det["index"], arr)
        interp.invoke()
        out_det = interp.get_output_details()[0]
        ref = np.ascontiguousarray(interp.get_tensor(out_det["index"]),
                                   dtype=LE_FLOAT32)
        _to_bin(ref, dest / "sleeping1_ref.bin")
    else:
        print("  [warn] cannot run model to compute ref; only input exported")

    manifest = {
        "model": "funt_apple_2026-01-01-12-37-22.tflite",
        "source_csv": str(csv_path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)),
        "csv_rows": n_rows,
        "window": win,
        "features": feat_len,
        "input_shape": list(arr.shape),
        "note": "CSV rows zero-padded to 1800-window; ref computed via "
                "ai_edge_litert XNNPACK (matches TFLM float reference path)",
    }
    _write_manifest(dest, manifest)
    print(f"Exported sleeping1 fixture to {dest}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

EXPORTERS = {
    "accnet_v3": export_accnet_v3,
    "attengru_v3": export_attengru_v3,
    "sleeping1": export_sleeping1,
}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Export .bin input/reference fixtures for accnet/attengru/sleeping"
    )
    parser.add_argument("model", choices=sorted(EXPORTERS),
                        help="which model fixture to export")
    parser.add_argument("--dest", required=True, type=Path,
                        help="output directory")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    EXPORTERS[args.model](args.dest)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def export_sleeping1(dest: Path, csv_name: str = "sleepdata1.csv") -> None:
    model = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_sleeping/source/funt_apple_2026-01-01-12-37-22.tflite"
    csv_path = REPO_ROOT / "PTQ_sleeping/source/data" / csv_name

    rows = []
    with open(csv_path, newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        for row in reader:
            feats = [float(x) for x in row[:49]]
            rows.append(feats)
    n_rows = len(rows)
    feat_len = 49
    win = 1800

- 处理:用 interpreter 拿到 input 量化参数(scale=0.2596, zp=0),把 f32 量化成 int8,生成 `input_int8.bin` 可直接喂设备端 int8 模型;同时保留 `input_f32.bin` 作源数据备份
- ref:同理量化成 `ref_int8.bin`(scale=0.0767, zp=-128)

**attengru_v3**(custom op 模型,PC 无法推理):

{"doc_id":"B4G6dQzMJooXZbxLV6Ac3fqKnbc","length":47352,"log_id":"2026082717230922D830FE257B758B57DA","markdown":"## O62 Cortex-M55 MVE-F 能力、CMSIS-NN 算子接入与真机验证报告
- **验证日期：** 2026-08-17
- **目标平台：** BES O62 AP / Arm Cortex-M55
- **涉及工程：** `vela-miwear-bes-o62-25rc05-tflm`
<callout emoji="white_check_mark" background-color="light-green">
最终结论：O62 真机执行 `SCB_GetMVEType()` 返回 **2**，已经直接证明硬件和当前固件支持浮点向量扩展 MVE-F。现有 TFLM/CMSIS-NN 已为 INT8 Conv/FC 接入 MVE-I 优化，但普通 FP32 Conv/FC 仍走 TFLM reference 实现，没有接入现成的 CMSIS-NN FP32 MVE 快速内核。

### 1. `SCB_GetMVEType()` 返回值含义
根据 [Arm CMSIS Core MVE Functions](https://arm-software.github.io/CMSIS_6/main/Core/group__mve__functions.html)，返回值含义如下：

<lark-table rows="4" cols="3" header-row="true" column-widths="244,244,244">

  <lark-tr>
    <lark-td>
      返回值
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      含义
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      能力
    </lark-td>
  </lark-tr>
  <lark-tr>
    <lark-td>
      `0`
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      无 MVE
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      不支持 MVE 向量扩展
    </lark-td>
  </lark-tr>
  <lark-tr>
    <lark-td>
      `1`
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      MVE-I
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      支持整数向量扩展
    </lark-td>
  </lark-tr>
  <lark-tr>
    <lark-td>
      `2`
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      MVE-F
    </lark-td>
    <lark-td>
      支持浮点向量扩展，同时具备整数 MVE 能力
    </lark-td>
  </lark-tr>
</lark-table>

`2` 是**能力类型枚举**，不是“两路并行”。MVE/Helium 的向量寄存器宽度为 128 bit，因此对于 FP32 数据，理论上一条合适的向量指令通常可以并行处理：
```plaintext
128 bit / 32 bit = 4 个 FP32 lane

```

所以，返回 `2` 说明平台具备开发 FP32 SIMD 快速内核的硬件条件，但不代表当前模型中的 FP32 Conv/FC 已经自动使用了该能力。
### 2. O62 编译期静态证据
O62 实际编译配置包含：
```plaintext
-mtune=cortex-m55
-march=armv8.1-m.main+dsp+mve.fp+fp.dp
-mfpu=fpv5-d16
-mfloat-abi=hard
-O3
-DCMSIS_NN

```

使用相同交叉编译器和完整目标参数检查预定义宏，得到：
```c
#define __ARM_FP 14
#define __ARM_FEATURE_MVE 3

```

其中 `__ARM_FEATURE_MVE == 3` 表示编译目标同时启用了 MVE 整数和浮点能力。该静态证据此前已经表明 O62 固件应支持 MVE-F；本报告第 7 节的真机结果进一步完成了运行时确认。
### 3. TFLM 中 CMSIS-NN 的构建接入方式
启用 `CONFIG_MLEARNING_CMSIS_NN` 后，`apps/mlearning/tflite-micro/CMakeLists.txt` 会：
1. 收集 `tensorflow/lite/micro/kernels/cmsis_nn/*.cc`；
1. 从 generic kernel 源文件集合中删除同名实现，如 `kernels/conv.cc`、`kernels/fully_connected.cc`；
1. 加入 `kernels/cmsis_nn/conv.cc`、`kernels/cmsis_nn/fully_connected.cc`；
1. 将 vendored CMSIS-NN `Source/` 编译为静态库并链接。
模型侧仍然使用标准注册接口：
```cpp
resolver.AddConv2D();
resolver.AddFullyConnected();

```

但最终链接到的 `Register_CONV_2D()` 和 `Register_FULLY_CONNECTED()` 来自 `kernels/cmsis_nn/`。也就是说，接入方式是**构建阶段替换同名 TFLM wrapper**，然后 wrapper 再根据 tensor 类型决定调用 reference 实现还是 CMSIS-NN。
### 4. INT8 Conv 已接入 CMSIS-NN/MVE
INT8 Conv2D 的调用链为：
```plaintext
TFLite INT8 CONV_2D
  → resolver.AddConv2D()
  → Register_CONV_2D()
  → kernels/cmsis_nn/conv.cc
  → Prepare()
      → arm_convolve_wrapper_s8_get_buffer_size()
      → RequestScratchBufferInArena()
  → Eval()：input type == kTfLiteInt8
  → EvalQuantizedPerChannel()
  → convolve_wrapper<int8_t>()
  → arm_convolve_wrapper_s8()
  → CMSIS-NN 根据 shape 选择具体 s8 kernel

```

`arm_convolve_wrapper_s8()` 会根据卷积参数选择：
- `arm_convolve_1x1_s8_fast()`；
- `arm_convolve_1x1_s8()`；
- `arm_convolve_1_x_n_s8()`；
- `arm_convolve_s8()`。
CMSIS-NN 通过如下条件启用整数 MVE 路径：
```c
#if defined(__ARM_FEATURE_MVE) && (__ARM_FEATURE_MVE & 1)
#define ARM_MATH_MVEI
#endif

```

O62 上 `__ARM_FEATURE_MVE == 3`，因此 `3 & 1 == 1`，CMSIS-NN 会编译 `ARM_MATH_MVEI` 对应的 INT8 MVE intrinsic 实现。
### 5. INT8 FullyConnected 已接入 CMSIS-NN/MVE
常规 INT8 FC 调用链为：
```plaintext
TFLite INT8 FULLY_CONNECTED
  → resolver.AddFullyConnected()
  → Register_FULLY_CONNECTED()
  → kernels/cmsis_nn/fully_connected.cc
  → Prepare() 申请 scratch buffer
  → Eval() / EvalInt8()
  → arm_fully_connected_wrapper_s8()
  → arm_fully_connected_s8()
     或 arm_fully_connected_per_channel_s8()
  → arm_nn_vec_mat_mult_t_s8()
  → ARM_MATH_MVEI 向量实现

```

部分满足条件的 FC 还会转换为 `arm_convolve_1x1_s8_fast()` 快速路径，例如 output rank 大于 2 且累加深度满足 4 字节对齐时。
### 6. FP32 Conv/FC 为什么没有使用 MVE-F
当前 TFLM CMSIS-NN wrapper 中，普通 FP32 分支如下：
```plaintext
FP32 Conv
  → kernels/cmsis_nn/conv.cc
  → kTfLiteFloat32
  → tflite::reference_ops::Conv(...)

FP32 FullyConnected
  → kernels/cmsis_nn/fully_connected.cc
  → kTfLiteFloat32
  → tflite::reference_ops::FullyConnected(...)

```

只有 INT8/INT16 分支调用 `arm_*_s8/s16` CMSIS-NN API。因此，文件位于 `kernels/cmsis_nn/` 并不意味着所有数据类型都经过 CMSIS-NN 优化。
主要原因不是 O62 配置遗漏，而是：
1. CMSIS-NN 主要面向定点/量化神经网络，提供 `arm_convolve_*_s8/s16`、`arm_fully_connected_*_s8` 等接口；
1. 当前 vendored CMSIS-NN 没有可直接接入 TFLM 的通用 `arm_convolve_f32` 或 `arm_fully_connected_f32`；
1. 通用 FP32 Conv 内核需要额外覆盖 kernel、stride、padding、dilation、通道布局、尾部处理、bias、activation 和数值误差；
1. `-O3` 可能让编译器自动向量化 reference 实现的一部分循环，但这不等同于经过数据布局和访存优化的专用 MVE-F 快速内核，需检查汇编和性能数据才能确认实际收益。

### 8. 对 PNet FP32 Conv1 优化的影响
PNet Stage0 Conv1 当前路径为：
```plaintext
resolver.AddConv2D()
  → kernels/cmsis_nn/conv.cc
  → kTfLiteFloat32
  → reference_ops::Conv

```

真机 `MVE type=2` 证明硬件具备 FP32 SIMD 条件，但不会自动改变上述软件分派。若要加速该层，需要新增或接入 FP32 MVE-F 内核。
推荐按以下顺序推进：
1. **建立基线**：记录 Stage0 Conv1 的固定 input/filter/output shape、stride、padding、activation、单次耗时和整网占比；
1. **检查现有汇编**：确认 `reference_ops::Conv` 是否已经被 `-O3` 自动向量化，以及实际生成的 MVE 指令比例；
1. **开发专用内核**：优先针对 Stage0 Conv1 的固定 shape 实现专用 FP32 Conv1D/Conv2D MVE-F intrinsic 内核，而不是一开始覆盖通用 Conv2D；
1. **接入 TFLM wrapper**：在 `kTfLiteFloat32` 分支中仅对严格匹配的 shape/参数走 fast path，其余情况保持 `reference_ops::Conv` fallback；
1. **数值验证**：与 reference 输出逐元素比较，制定最大绝对误差、平均误差和业务侧回归阈值；
1. **性能验证**：在 O62 真机测量 cycles、耗时、RAM/scratch、代码体积，并确认整网端到端收益；
1. **逐步通用化**：只有专用内核收益明确后，再抽象公共接口并扩展其他 FP32 Conv/FC shape。
<callout emoji="bulb" background-color="light-blue">
建议首先选择固定 shape 的 PNet Stage0 FP32 Conv1 作为 PoC。该方案开发范围最小、fallback 清晰、最容易证明真实性能收益；直接开发通用 FP32 Conv2D/FC backend 的复杂度和验证成本明显更高。
</callout>

### 9. 最终结论
- O62 真机 `SCB_GetMVEType()` 返回 **2**，确认支持 MVE-F；
- `2` 表示能力类型，不是并行路数；MVE 为 128-bit，FP32 通常对应 4 lane；
- O62 编译器已经启用 MVE-FP，静态宏为 `__ARM_FEATURE_MVE=3`；
- 当前 INT8 Conv/FC 已通过 TFLM CMSIS-NN wrapper 接入 `arm_*_s8`，并启用 MVE-I；
- 当前普通 FP32 Conv/FC 没有现成 CMSIS-NN FP32 kernel，仍走 TFLM reference 实现；
- 硬件能力已经验证，下一步工作的重点是软件侧实现并接入专用 FP32 MVE-F 快速内核，并用真机数值与性能数据判断收益。

### 11.3 Wrapper 分派设计
<whiteboard token="MEcWwNwAEhacLQbBqCucWuiInMe" align="left"/>

Wrapper 分成三个职责单一的接口：
- `IsPnetV3Conv1F32`：严格检查 tensor 类型、shape、stride、padding、dilation 和 activation。
- `PreparePnetV3Conv1F32`：生成 CMSIS-NN 参数并申请 scratch；不支持或申请失败时保持禁用，不影响原路径。
- `EvalPnetV3Conv1F32`：仅在已启用时调用 `arm_convolve_f32`；调用失败返回 false，由 `conv.cc` 执行 reference fallback。
Kconfig 开关 `CONFIG_MLEARNING_CMSIS_NN_PNET_V3_CONV1_F32` 控制专用代码，并向 CMSIS-NN 增加 `ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=1`。关闭开关后，FP32 Conv 行为与原实现一致。

### 12.1 “特制算子”如何设计

#### 12.1.1 `arm_convolve_f32` 的硬件加速原理
`arm_convolve_f32` 是 **NHWC FP32 卷积的分派入口**，不是单一计算循环。它先根据 shape 选择 1×1、1×N、direct 或通用 patch-GEMM 内核；真正的硬件加速来自编译条件 `ARM_MATH_MVEF && !ARM_MATH_AUTOVECTORIZE` 下的 MVE-F intrinsic 分支。未启用该条件时会回退到非 MVE 实现。
<whiteboard token="TPNsw9yHEhubjCblVCQcUB4ZnHd" align="left"/>

当前 PNet Conv1 为 `1×21` kernel、stride width=`2`、Valid。它实际进入 `arm_convolve_1_x_n_nhwc_f32`，主要执行无 padding 的 `no_pad_num` 区域，再调用 strided 1×N 矩阵乘内核；因此合法窗口可直接按 stride 读取，不需要先把每个窗口复制为通用 im2row patch。

### 12.2 问题、分析与解决闭环
<whiteboard token="OBwkwy0KUhrUuxbiy8HcFvx3nXf" align="left"/>

最关键的软件缺陷位于 `conv.cc::Prepare()`：Conv bias 是输入 #2，却误用 output accessor。`Eval()` 仍从 input 读取，所以整网数值正确，但匹配器始终拒绝目标层。
```cpp
// 修复前
AllocateTempOutputTensor(node, kConvBiasTensor);
// 修复后
AllocateTempInputTensor(node, kConvBiasTensor);

```

修复后使用同一 `build_tflm.sh` 全量重建、烧录，原失败用例转为通过。最终固件 `vela_ap.bin` 为 `11,097,884 bytes`，SHA256：`bd885d481eb38ae65f0e6871ca3546c41c1be0f54e41bb4caf9687fae4d11afe`。

输出被 sensor flood 严重污染,而且字符逐个来了——921600 波特率下 reader 把 flood 也全收进来了,我的过滤太粗暴。问题在于 `cat` 回显的内容被 flood 字节冲散了。

回看之前会话验证过的有效做法:**命令输出重定向到文件,再用 `dd` 按块读回**（不是 `cat`,因为 `cat` 的输出会和 flood 混在 stdout,而 `dd` 指定 bs 一次读整块）。而且关键发现是"syslog flood 不进入 stdout 重定向"——也就是说 `cmd > /data/x.txt 2>&1` 的文件内容是干净的,只是从串口 `cat` 回来时会混入 flood。

更好的办法:用 `dd` 读文件并立即重定向到另一个干净的读取方式,或者干脆把文件内容通过 `xxd`/`od` 分块吐出。但最稳的是:**相信重定向文件是干净的,用 `dd if=/data/x.txt bs=4096` 单次读,reader 线程收完后我从 buffer 里 grep 目标行**。

我换一个思路:不依赖实时 cat 回显,而是把所有需要的命令都重定向到文件,跑完后,用 `dd` 逐文件读,每个 dd 输出前后加 `echo MARK_xxx` 标记,然后从整个 reader buffer 里按标记切片提取。这样即使 flood 混入,我也能靠标记定位干净段。

input.command:
cat > /tmp/probe2.py << 'PYEOF'
import serial, time, threading, re

PORT="/dev/ttyACM1"
BAUD=921600
s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()
stop=False
buf=bytearray()
def reader():
    while not stop:
        d=s.read(4096)
        if d: buf.extend(d)
t=threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True); t.start()

def send(cmd, settle=1.2):
    s.write(b"\x03\x15"); time.sleep(0.3)
    s.write(cmd.encode()+b"\r\n")
    time.sleep(settle)

def readback(path, label, bs=8192):
    """dd file -> stdout, wrapped in MARK labels. Returns extracted text."""
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_START", 0.4)
    send(f"dd if={path} bs={bs} 2>/dev/null", 1.5)
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_END", 0.4)

# 1. redirect commands to files
send("ls -l /data > /data/_ls.txt 2>&1", 1.5)
send("free > /data/_free.txt 2>&1", 1.2)
send("tflm_benchmark > /data/_help.txt 2>&1", 1.5)
# also probe: does attengru model even load? we'll see via benchmark run later

# 2. read them back with marks
readback("/data/_ls.txt", "LS")
readback("/data/_free.txt", "FREE")
readback("/data/_help.txt", "HELP")

time.sleep(2)
stop=True
s.close()
text = bytes(buf).decode(errors="replace")

def extract(label):
    m = re.search(rf"MARK_{label}_START\r?\n(.*?)MARK_{label}_END", text, re.S)
    if not m: return f"[NO MARK for {label}]"
    chunk = m.group(1)
    # strip sensor flood lines from chunk
    lines = [l for l in chunk.splitlines()
             if "get_cur_batty" not in l and "temperature protect" not in l and l.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines)

print("============ LS ============")
print(extract("LS"))
print("============ FREE ============")
print(extract("FREE"))
print("============ HELP ============")
print(extract("HELP"))

**1. `tflm_benchmark` 命令格式**（决定性约束）:

关键信息全部到手了。用户补充的命令格式确认了:`hr_pnet_test` 子命令只接受 pnet 系列模型 + `hr_pnet_input.bin` + `hr_pnet_ref.bin`,**不能用于 accnet/attengru/sleeping**。

而通用形式 `tflm_benchmark filename [--csv]` 的实测结果给出了答案:

## 通用形式实测结论

**通用形式 `tflm_benchmark <model> [--csv]` 确实可跑,且输出:**
- **推理时间**:`"total number of ticks", N` + 各算子 ticks(dnn_small=1587, cnn_small=8362)
- **Input CRC32 / Output CRC32**:有(但这是零输入/dummy input 的 CRC,不是真实数据对的精度)
- **Arena**:Total/NonPersistent/Persistent 字节数(dnn_small Arena=4276B, cnn_small=18404B)
- **无 PASS/max_abs_diff 判定**:通用形式不做与外部 ref 的逐元素比对

**attengru_v3_hybrid 跑了 6s 没出 MARK_G3** —— 大概率是 custom op load 失败或卡死。这是个阻塞点,但通用形式下 attengru 即便能跑也没有 input/ref 比对。

## 重新理解任务边界

用户要的两类数据,我现在能诚实交付的:

**1. 参数规模/ROM/RAM(→ 飞书 ZXbt)**:
- ROM = 模型文件大小(`/data` 下 `.tflite` 字节数,通用形式也报 Arena)
- RAM = `free`(已有)+ `tflm_benchmark` 报的 Arena(NonPersistent+Persistent)
- 这个对所有模型都能跑出来(通用形式即可)

**2. 精度 PASS + 推理时间(→ 飞书 B4G6)**:
- **推理时间**:所有模型都能拿到(通用形式 `"total number of ticks"`)
- **精度 PASS**:只有 `hr_pnet_test` 三参数形式能做 CRC/max_abs_diff/PASS 判定,且**只对 pnet 系列模型 + hr_pnet_input.bin + hr_pnet_ref.bin 成立**。用户给的命令列表正好全是 pnet 系列(v2/v3 full/skip)。

这是一个需要用户决策的分叉,我不能猜着跑。先把 attengru 到底是死是活、以及 pnet 全系列命令的真实输出拿到,因为用户明确列了 pnet 的 4 条命令要跑。同时 accnet/sleeping 的精度验证在通用形式下无法做——这个事实必须告知用户。

但先把能确定的 pnet 系列全跑完(用户给了明确命令),这些能产出精度 PASS + 时间。attengru 的 load 失败再单独确认一次。先跑 pnet 4 条 + 重试 attengru,用我验证过的标记切片法:

import serial, time, threading, re

PORT="/dev/ttyACM1"
BAUD=921600
s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()
stop=False
buf=bytearray()
def reader():
    while not stop:
        d=s.read(4096)
        if d: buf.extend(d)
t=threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True); t.start()

def send(cmd, settle=1.2):
    s.write(b"\x03\x15"); time.sleep(0.3)
    s.write(cmd.encode()+b"\r\n")
    time.sleep(settle)

def readback(path, label, bs=12000, settle=2.0):
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_START", 0.4)
    send(f"dd if={path} bs={bs} 2>/dev/null", settle)
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_END", 0.4)

def run_bench(label, model, settle=25):
    send(f"tflm_benchmark hr_pnet_test {model} /data/hr_pnet_input.bin /data/hr_pnet_ref.bin > /data/_p_{label}.txt 2>&1", settle)
    send(f"echo {label}_DONE >> /data/_p_{label}.txt", 0.3)
    readback(f"/data/_p_{label}.txt", label, settle=2.0)

# User's 4 pnet commands. Note: m.tflite == MiHr_pnet_v3_aiq_dynamic_skip_s0_conv1.tflite
run_bench("v2_skip",  "/data/MiHr_pnet_v2_aiq_dynamic_skip_s0_conv1.tflite", 20)
run_bench("v2_full",  "/data/MiHr_pnet_v2_aiq_dynamic_full.tflite", 20)
run_bench("v3_full",  "/data/MiHr_pnet_v3_aiq_dynamic_full.tflite", 25)
run_bench("v3_skip",  "/data/m.tflite", 25)

# Retry attengru with shorter settle to see error (not hang)
send("tflm_benchmark /data/attengru_v3_hybrid_model.tflite > /data/_atten.txt 2>&1", 8)
send("echo ATTEN_DONE >> /data/_atten.txt", 0.3)
readback("/data/_atten.txt", "ATTEN", settle=1.0)

time.sleep(2)
stop=True
s.close()
text = bytes(buf).decode(errors="replace")

def extract(label):
    m = re.search(rf"MARK_{label}_START\r?\n(.*?)MARK_{label}_END", text, re.S)
    if not m: return f"[NO MARK {label}]"
    chunk = m.group(1)
    lines = [l for l in chunk.splitlines()
             if "get_cur_batty" not in l and "temperature protect" not in l and l.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines)

for lab in ["v2_skip","v2_full","v3_full","v3_skip","ATTEN"]:
    print(f"\n===== {lab} =====")
    print(extract(lab))

- 或者 v2_full / v3_full / v2_skip 的命令行太长被 flood 截断(之前会话遇到过"长命令被截断")
- ATTEN 依然 NO MARK

解决方案之前验证过:**把模型 mv 成短名**。我重跑这 4 个,先把长名模型 mv 成短名(`p1.tflite` 等),再跑。同时 attengru 用短名重试看真实错误。

import serial, time, threading, re

PORT="/dev/ttyACM1"
BAUD=921600
s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()
stop=False

def reader():
    while not stop:
        d=s.read(4096)
        if d: buf.extend(d)
t=threading.Thread(target=reader,daemon=True); t.start()

def send(cmd, settle=1.2):
    s.write(b"\x03\x15"); time.sleep(0.3)
    s.write(cmd.encode()+b"\r\n")
    time.sleep(settle)

def readback(path, label, bs=12000, settle=2.0):
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_START", 0.4)
    send(f"dd if={path} bs={bs} 2>/dev/null", settle)
    send(f"echo MARK_{label}_END", 0.4)

def run_pnet(label, model, settle=25):

time.sleep(2)
stop=True
s.close()
text = bytes(buf).decode(errors="replace")

def extract(label):
    m = re.search(rf"MARK_{label}_START\r?\n(.*?)MARK_{label}_END", text, re.S)
    if not m: return f"[NO MARK {label}]"
    chunk = m.group(1)
    lines = [l for l in chunk.splitlines()
             if "get_cur_batty" not in l and "temperature protect" not in l and l.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines)

for lab in ["v2s","v2f","v3f","AT3","SL","AC3"]:
    print(f"\n===== {lab} =====")
    print(extract(lab))

全部 NO MARK。连 CHK(ls -l 短名文件)都没产出——这说明设备串口状态可能已经异常(之前的后台跑完后串口没恢复,或 sensor flood 把所有命令都淹了)。

除非——`Unable to open` 是 hr_pnet_test 内部对 input/ref 之外的某个探测,而 benchmark 本身从命令行第一个非选项参数取 model。但 v2_skip 报 `input size mismatch: 1024 vs 4096`,说明 v2 模型 input 是 1024 字节,它确实加载了 v2 模型(p2s.tflite)才能知道期望 1024。所以模型**是**打开的,`Unable to open model file: p2s.tflite` 这行可能来自别的代码路径或误导。

关键:CHK 都 NO MARK,说明串口现在不通。先做最基本的串口连通性检查——发个 `echo HI` 看回显,并确认短名文件是否存在。可能需要重新打开串口/复位设备。

但在继续之前,我得退一步想清楚边界,不能一直盲目试。

## 我现在确凿掌握的事实

1. **`hr_pnet_test` 只服务 pnet**,且要求 input/ref 与模型版本匹配:
   - pnet v3: input 4096B / ref 256B → ✅ PASS(已验证 71289 ticks, max_abs_diff=0)
   - pnet v3 full(p3f): 71228 ticks 但 **max_abs_diff=6.39** → FAIL。v3 full 与 v3 skip 的 ref 不同!v3 full 的 ref.bin 不对(用 skip_s0_conv1 的 ref 喂 full 模型)。
   - pnet v2: input 应 1024B,但只有 4096B 的 v3 input → size mismatch,跑不了。

2. **通用形式 `tflm_benchmark <model>` 能给**:推理 ticks + Arena + Input/Output CRC,但**无 PASS 判定**(不与外部 ref 比对)。

3. **attengru/sleep/accnet**:ATTEN/AT/SL/AC 全 NO MARK——还没拿到一次成功输出。attengru 含 custom op,极可能 load 就失败;sleep/accnet 待定但连 CHK 都失败说明是串口问题不是模型问题。

## 我需要向用户澄清的关键分叉

在继续投入之前,有一个事实必须摆给用户:用户给的命令列表全是 **pnet 系列 + 同一份 hr_pnet_input.bin/hr_pnet_ref.bin**。但实测证明:
- v2 模型 input shape 与 v3 不同(1024 vs 4096)→ v2 命令用 v3 的 input 会 size mismatch,**v2 命令跑不了**
- v3 full 用 v3 skip_s0_conv1 的 ref → ref 不匹配 → FAIL(不是精度问题,是喂错了 ref)

而且 **accnet/attengru/sleeping 没有 `hr_pnet_test` 等价子命令**,通用形式只报 ticks+CRC,不报 PASS/max_abs_diff。

我不能假装这些都能产出"精度 PASS"。先把串口恢复、把能跑的 pnet v3 skip(唯一 input/ref 匹配的)确认数据坐实,同时把 attengru/sleep/accnet 的通用形式至少跑出 ticks+Arena(参数规模那篇需要),然后如实告知用户精度验证的边界。

两个重要发现:

1. **`nsh: ls: too many arguments`** — NSH 的 `ls` 只接受**单参数**!之前会话总结里就记录过这个限制。所以 `ls -l /data/p2s.tflite /data/p3f...` 多文件失败。要一个个 ls。
2. **AC 和 SL 的 dd 读回只有标记 `ACE`/`SLE` 没有内容** — 说明 `_ac.txt`/`_sl.txt` 文件是空的(benchmark 命令没产出输出,或文件没生成)。attengru `_a.txt` NO MARK 说明 dd 命令本身没送进去或文件空。
3. CHK 用 `ls -l` 多参数失败,但我可以用 `ls /data/p2s.tflite` 单个查。

关键：accnet/sleep/attengru 的 benchmark **根本没产出输出**（空文件）。这强烈暗示这些模型在通用形式下 load 就失败（attengru custom op 必然；accnet/sleep 可能 input 问题或卡住）。

但 AC/SL 文件空也可能是命令没执行（被 flood 截断）。我必须区分：是命令没跑，还是跑了但无输出。用单参数 ls 确认文件大小，并改用 `cat` 看是否有任何报错。先逐个确认文件存在性 + 重跑时把 stderr 合并：

源码读完了,结论很清晰。我把 `tflm_benchmark` 的两种形式和支持能力彻底搞清楚了:

## `tflm_benchmark` 命令能力(源码确认)

### 两种形式

**形式 1:通用形式** `tflm_benchmark filename [--csv]`(generic_model_benchmark.cc:641-642)
- argc=2 或 3,只接受模型文件名 + 可选 `--csv`
- **不加载任何 input/ref 文件**,输入用随机种子填充(SetRandomInput, kRandomSeed=0xFB)
- 输出:CRC32(ticks 分算子统计)+ Arena 用量
- **没有 PASS 判定**——没有 input/ref 比对逻辑

**形式 2:pnet 形式** `tflm_benchmark hr_pnet_test model input reference [--csv] [--conv=baseline|optimized]`(generic_model_benchmark.cc:643-646)
- argv[1] **必须字面等于 `"hr_pnet_test"`** 才进 pnet_mode(generic_model_benchmark.cc:670-671)
- 加载 model + input + ref 三个文件
- `SetPnetInput` 强制校验:**输入必须是 FLOAT32 [1,1,256] 或 [1,4,256]**(generic_model_benchmark.cc:367-368)
- `ValidatePnetOutput` 强制校验:**输出必须是 FLOAT32 [1,1,64]**(generic_model_benchmark.cc:393-395)
- 容差 1e-2,逐元素比对 → PASS/FAIL

### 关键结论

1. **PASS 判定是 pnet 专属的,硬编码了输入/输出 shape 校验**:`SetPnetInput` 写死 `[1,1,256]`/`[1,4,256]`,`ValidatePnetOutput` 写死 `[1,1,64]`。这意味着:
   - **ML-zoo 的 7 个模型**(cnn_small/dnn_small/dnn_medium/ds_cnn_large/kws_s/kws_m/vww4)——输入 shape 都不是 `[1,{1,4},256]`,**就算强行喂 input/ref 也会被 `SetPnetInput` 拒掉**。而且这些是 int8 模型,pnet 路径要求 FLOAT32 输入,类型也对不上。**PASS 无法拿到**。
   - **accnet**(输入 `[1,3,256]` int8)——shape `[1,3,256]` 不在 pnet 允许的 `[1,1,256]`/`[1,4,256]` 内,且 int8 ≠ float32。**PASS 无法拿到**。
   - **attengru/sleep**——多输入/自定义算子/大输入,更不可能走 pnet 路径。**PASS 无法拿到**。

2. **没有第三种形式**:`usage()` 只列了两行,`main()` 的 `pnet_mode` 判断是 `strcmp(argv[1], "hr_pnet_test")`,else 分支就是通用形式(只读模型)。源码里**不存在**「通用形式带 input/ref」的路径。`pnet_mode` 这个布尔量控制了整个比对分支是否执行(generic_model_benchmark.cc:463, 553, 581, 614, 626)。

3. **通用形式对非 pnet 模型仍可跑通**(之前已验证):能拿到 ticks + Input/Output CRC32 + Arena 统计。这部分数据对"参数规模 + 推理时间"那篇飞书文档是有价值的,只是对"精度 PASS"那篇没有 PASS 列可填。

## 方向 2 的结论

**`tflm_benchmark` 确认只有两种形式,通用形式无法带 input/ref 做 PASS。** 非 pnet 模型(ML-zoo 7 个 + accnet + attengru + sleep)在当前固件下:
- ✅ 能用通用形式跑出 **ticks + CRC + Arena**(推理时间 + 内存统计可填)
- ❌ **拿不到 PASS 判定**(pnet 路径硬校验 shape/type,非 pnet 模型进不去)

要想让非 pnet 模型也拿 PASS,只有两条路:

这正是我需要的路径。`hr_accnet_test` 已经是一个**完整的 PASS 比对应用**:
- 从 /data 加载 `hr_accnet_model.tflite` + `hr_accnet_input.bin` + `hr_accnet_ref.bin`
- int8 逐元素比对,容差 2 → PASS/FAIL

- arena 128KB
- 用专属 op_resolver(13 个算子,但注意:这里没注册自定义算子,accnet 是纯标准算子)

现在读 attengru 和 sleep 的专属 test,确认它们是否注册了自定义算子(LAYER_NORM/GRU/MHA),以及加载/比对逻辑。这是判断 attengru/sleep 能否通过专属应用跑通的关键。

完全确认了。`hr_attengru_test` 是完整 PASS 应用:
- **注册了自定义算子**:`LAYER_NORM`、`UNIDIRECTIONAL_SEQUENCE_GRU`、`MULTI_HEAD_ATTENTION`(通过 `Register_LAYER_NORM()` 等外部函数)。这解释了为什么 generic 形式跑不通——generic 的 `op_resolver_no_signal` 没注册这些。
- 多输入/多输出张量,按 offset 顺序拼接 input.bin/ref.bin
- float32 比对,容差 1e-2 → PASS/FAIL
- arena 80KB
- main 名直接是 `main`(CMakeLists 用 `-Dmain=hr_attengru_test_main` 重命名)

现在读 sleep_board_test.cc,确认它的算子注册和 PASS 逻辑(睡眠模型 1800 窗口,arena 要够大)。

全部确认完毕。现在我有完整的图景。`sleep_board_test` 也是完整 PASS 应用:
- 注册 `BIDIRECTIONAL_SEQUENCE_GRU` + `LAYER_NORM` 自定义算子
- **arena 1280KB**(1.25MB)——够大,解决了之前 generic 64KB arena 太小的问题
- 一次跑两个模型:float32(容差 1e-4)+ hybrid_int8(容差 1e-2),各自 PASS/FAIL
- 5 次 invoke 取平均耗时(ms)
- 但路径**硬编码** `/data/sleep_model.tflite` 等,不接受命令行参数

## 方案重新评估

原方案是改 `generic_model_benchmark.cc` 加通用 PASS 子命令。但现在发现**固件里已经存在 4 个专属 PASS 应用**(`hr_pnet_test`/`hr_accnet_test`/`hr_attengru_test`/`sleep_test`),每个都已注册正确的算子(含自定义算子)、已实现 PASS 比对、已设好合适的 arena。

这比改 generic 优越得多——但是否已编译进当前设备固件,取决于 defconfig 里 `CONFIG_TFLITEMICRO_HYBRID_TEST` / `CONFIG_TFLITEMICRO_ACCNET_HYBRID_TEST` / `CONFIG_TFLITEMICRO_HR_TEST` / `CONFIG_TFLITEMICRO_SLEEP_TEST` 是否开启。需要先查当前 O62 defconfig 确认哪些已编入。

PORT = "/dev/ttyACM1"
BAUD = 921600

s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()

stop = False
log_buf = bytearray()
def reader():
    global log_buf
    while not stop:
        d = s.read(4096)
        if d:
            log_buf.extend(d)

import threading
t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True)
t.start()

def send(cmd, settle=1.5):
    s.write(cmd.encode() + b"\r\n")
    time.sleep(settle)

def send_bytes(b, settle=1.5):
    s.write(b)
    time.sleep(settle)

# interrupt + clear
send_bytes(b"\x03", 0.5)
send_bytes(b"\x15", 0.5)
send("\r\n", 0.5)
time.sleep(1)

# list /data to file (NSH ls takes single arg, so one-by-one via find-like)
# Use: ls /data > file, but ls may not support redirect cleanly with flood.
# Strategy: ls /data/ > /data/_ls.txt 2>&1 ; echo MARK_LS ; then dd readback
send("ls /data/ > /data/_ls.txt 2>&1", 2)
send("echo MARK_LS_START >> /data/_ls.txt", 0.5)
send("dd if=/data/_ls.txt bs=20000 2>/dev/null", 3)
send("echo MARK_LS_END", 0.5)

time.sleep(2)
stop = True
s.close()

out = log_buf.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
# extract between MARK_LS_START and MARK_LS_END
m = re.search(r"MARK_LS_START(.*?)MARK_LS_END", out, re.DOTALL)
if m:
    print("=== /data listing ===")
    print(m.group(1))
else:
    print("=== NO MARK found, raw tail ===")
    print(out[-3000:])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run hr_accnet_test on O62: transfer int8 fixtures, run, capture PASS result."""
import serial, time, re, sys

PORT = "/dev/ttyACM1"
BAUD = 921600
HTTP = "http://10.189.134.120:8080"

s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()

stop = False
log_buf = bytearray()
def reader():
    while not stop:
        d = s.read(8192)
        if d:
            log_buf.extend(d)

import threading
t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True)
t.start()

def send(cmd, settle=1.5):
    s.write(cmd.encode() + b"\r\n")
    time.sleep(settle)

def send_bytes(b, settle=1.5):
    s.write(b)
    time.sleep(settle)

# interrupt + clear
send_bytes(b"\x03", 0.5)
send_bytes(b"\x15", 0.5)
send("\r\n", 0.5)
time.sleep(1)

# 1. check network
send("ifconfig > /data/_ifc.txt 2>&1", 2)
send("echo MARK_IFC >> /data/_ifc.txt", 0.3)
send("dd if=/data/_ifc.txt bs=3000 2>/dev/null", 2)
send("echo MARK_IFC_END", 0.3)

# 2. wget fixtures (accnet_v3 int8 model already on device, but fetch in correct name)
#    Use HTTP server serving accnet_v3_fixtures dir
send_bytes(b"\x03", 0.3)
send(f"wget {HTTP}/accnet_v3_model.tflite -O /data/hr_accnet_model.tflite > /data/_w1.txt 2>&1", 8)
send(f"wget {HTTP}/accnet_v3_input_int8.bin -O /data/hr_accnet_input.bin > /data/_w2.txt 2>&1", 5)
send(f"wget {HTTP}/accnet_v3_ref_int8.bin -O /data/hr_accnet_ref.bin > /data/_w3.txt 2>&1", 5)
send("echo MARK_WGET_DONE", 0.3)

# 3. verify file sizes
send("ls /data/hr_accnet_model.tflite > /data/_ls_acc.txt 2>&1", 0.5)
send("ls /data/hr_accnet_input.bin >> /data/_ls_acc.txt 2>&1", 0.5)
send("ls /data/hr_accnet_ref.bin >> /data/_ls_acc.txt 2>&1", 0.5)
send("echo MARK_LS_ACC >> /data/_ls_acc.txt", 0.3)
send("dd if=/data/_ls_acc.txt bs=2000 2>/dev/null", 2)
send("echo MARK_LS_ACC_END", 0.3)

# 4. run hr_accnet_test (no args; loads fixed names from /data)
send_bytes(b"\x03", 0.3)
send("hr_accnet_test > /data/_acc_res.txt 2>&1", 15)
send("echo MARK_ACC_DONE >> /data/_acc_res.txt", 0.3)
send("dd if=/data/_acc_res.txt bs=20000 2>/dev/null", 4)
send("echo MARK_ACC_END", 0.3)

time.sleep(2)
stop = True
s.close()

out = log_buf.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
# Save full raw
with open("/tmp/accnet_raw.log", "w") as f:
    f.write(out)

# extract interesting sections
for mark_start, mark_end, label in [
    ("MARK_IFC", "MARK_IFC_END", "ifconfig"),
    ("MARK_WGET_DONE", None, "wget done"),
    ("MARK_LS_ACC", "MARK_LS_ACC_END", "ls accnet"),
    ("MARK_ACC_DONE", "MARK_ACC_END", "hr_accnet_test result"),
]:
    if mark_end:
        m = re.search(rf"{mark_start}(.*?){mark_end}", out, re.DOTALL)
    else:
        m = re.search(rf"{mark_start}(.*)", out, re.DOTALL)
    if m:
        print(f"=== {label} ===")
        print(m.group(1).strip()[:4000])
        print()
